title: General Theory Supporting Materials Scaffold Atom Set
purpose: Draft physical, spiritual, and bridge atoms for the General Theory support layer behind the Master Equation.
global_guards: This pack is not canon promotion.
Bridge grades belong to mappings, not to the physical or spiritual definition atoms.
A physical definition does not prove a spiritual identity.
A spiritual meaning does not redefine the physics term.
Use isomorphism only after explicit maps, inverse checks, preservation/reflection, negative controls, and receipts exist.
Mind-map rendering is visualization, not evidence.

atoms.title: State
atoms.plain_definition: A state is the set of quantities needed to describe a system enough to measure it, compare it, or predict what can happen next.
atoms.technical_definition: A state is the complete or model-sufficient assignment of physical quantities for an experiment, measurement, or prediction about a mechanical or physical system.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Prediction requires a specified condition. Without a state, the system has not been described tightly enough for lawful change or comparison to be meaningful.
misuse_guards: Do not treat an incomplete state description as the whole object.
Do not identify physical state with moral or spiritual state without a bridge atom.
Do not imply prediction is possible before state variables are defined.
kill_conditions: A better canonical definition shows this description omits a required state component for the intended model.
The term is used to smuggle spiritual conclusions into the physical definition.

atoms.title: Condition
atoms.plain_definition: Condition names the real state a person, system, or relation is in before judgment, healing, correction, or prediction can be honest.
atoms.technical_definition: A spiritual condition is a bounded description of alignment, disorder, relation, capacity, and need within a person or community.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Spiritual change cannot be described honestly if the starting condition is hidden, mislabeled, or sentimentalized.
misuse_guards: Do not reduce spiritual condition to a numeric score.
Do not confuse a label with real diagnosis.
Do not claim physics proves spiritual condition.
kill_conditions: The spiritual definition cannot be distinguished from ordinary mood, behavior, or preference.
The concept cannot support any actual discernment or corrective action.

atoms.title: State to Condition
atoms.claim: Physical state and spiritual condition share the structural need for honest description before prediction, judgment, correction, or transformation.
preserved_properties: need for defined quantities or qualities
not_claimed: Spiritual condition is not identical to a physical state vector.
The bridge does not prove a soul is physically measurable.
The bridge does not make moral judgment a physics calculation.
negative_guards: Bridge grade is not isomorphism.
No falsification should propagate to either base definition unless the definition itself fails.
kill_conditions: The mapping cannot name any shared structure beyond word similarity.
The spiritual side cannot define condition independently of physics language.

atoms.title: Table
atoms.plain_definition: A table is an ordered way to hold many possible quantities, cases, or configurations so they can be compared without losing their distinctions.
atoms.technical_definition: A table is a structured representation that aggregates physical quantities, regimes, cases, or permissible configurations for analysis.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: When many possibilities must remain distinguishable, a theory needs an ordered representation rather than a single narrative description.
misuse_guards: Do not mistake a table for explanation.
Do not confuse enumeration with proof.
Do not flatten unlike categories just because they can be placed in rows.
kill_conditions: The table cannot preserve meaningful distinctions among the cases it lists.
The table creates false equivalence between unlike domains.

atoms.title: Discernment
atoms.plain_definition: Discernment is the capacity to distinguish what kind of thing is present, what condition it is in, and what response is faithful.
atoms.technical_definition: Discernment is ordered spiritual judgment that preserves distinction among possibilities rather than collapsing them into impulse, fear, or preference.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Faithful response depends on knowing what kind of situation is actually present.
misuse_guards: Do not make discernment a private certainty immune to correction.
Do not confuse spiritual discernment with mere categorization.
Do not treat the table analogy as proof.
kill_conditions: The concept cannot produce distinctions that matter for action.
The discernment claim cannot be challenged by evidence, Scripture, or wise counsel.

atoms.title: Table to Discernment
atoms.claim: Tables and discernment both preserve distinctions across a field of possibilities so response does not collapse into confusion.
not_claimed: Discernment is not a spreadsheet.
A table does not decide moral truth.
Enumeration does not equal wisdom.
negative_guards: Use as analogy unless a formal decision structure is built.
No falsification propagation.
kill_conditions: The bridge adds no structure beyond the loose idea of organizing things.
The spiritual definition cannot name a real act of judgment.

atoms.title: Conservation
atoms.plain_definition: Conservation means a quantity does not simply disappear as a system changes, under the conditions where the relevant conservation law applies.
atoms.technical_definition: A conserved quantity remains invariant under specified dynamics, usually connected to symmetry, closure, or a governing conservation equation.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Conservation appears where the governing structure prevents a quantity from being created or destroyed without lawful accounting.
misuse_guards: Do not apply conservation outside its domain conditions.
Do not claim grace injects physical energy without accounting.
Do not confuse conservation with moral forgiveness.
kill_conditions: The supposed conserved quantity is not actually invariant under the specified model.
The claim ignores open-system boundaries or hidden source terms.

atoms.title: Moral Accounting
atoms.plain_definition: Moral accounting is the claim that action, cost, harm, debt, repair, and consequence cannot be made truthful by pretending they vanished.
atoms.technical_definition: Moral accounting tracks the persistence of consequence and cost in personal, relational, and covenantal order until judgment, repair, forgiveness, or redemption addresses them.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Wrongdoing changes a relational system. Truthful repair must account for what was done, who bore the cost, and how the order is restored.
misuse_guards: Do not reduce forgiveness to bookkeeping.
Do not claim every suffering is direct payment for a specific sin.
Do not make moral accounting a physics conservation law.
kill_conditions: The concept cannot distinguish justice from vengeance or repair from denial.
The account has no place for grace, mercy, or substitution without contradiction.

atoms.title: Conservation to Moral Accounting
atoms.claim: Conservation and moral accounting share a non-disappearance structure: change must be accounted for rather than rhetorically erased.
not_claimed: Moral debt is not physical energy.
Forgiveness does not violate physics.
Conservation laws do not prove atonement.
negative_guards: Bridge must not be used to claim moral cost is a conserved physical scalar.
Grace language must specify whether it restructures, pays, transforms, or reorders cost.
kill_conditions: The bridge cannot define what is preserved on the spiritual side.
The model implies free creation of physical energy or unaccounted moral cancellation.

atoms.title: Flux
atoms.plain_definition: Flux measures what passes through a boundary.
atoms.technical_definition: Flux is the quantity of a field, substance, energy, or other physical measure passing through a chosen surface or control boundary.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Flux appears when the relevant question is not only what a system contains, but what crosses the boundary of the system.
misuse_guards: Do not use flux language without specifying the boundary.
Do not confuse flux with total quantity stored inside the system.
Do not treat every spiritual influence as measurable physical flux.
kill_conditions: The model cannot define what boundary is being crossed.
The transferred quantity cannot be named.

atoms.title: Transfer
atoms.plain_definition: Transfer names the movement of cost, help, influence, burden, grace, witness, or responsibility across a relational boundary.
atoms.technical_definition: Spiritual transfer is a relational movement in which what belongs to one person, system, or domain affects another without collapsing the distinction between them.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Persons and communities are not sealed containers. Relation allows influence, cost, help, and harm to cross boundaries.
misuse_guards: Do not erase agency by saying everything transfers automatically.
Do not confuse influence with identity.
Do not claim spiritual transfer has a measured physical unit.
kill_conditions: The transfer claim cannot identify giver, receiver, boundary, or changed condition.
The concept becomes indistinguishable from vague influence.

atoms.title: Flux to Transfer
atoms.claim: Flux and spiritual transfer share a boundary-crossing structure: what matters is named by what passes from one side of a boundary to another.
not_claimed: Grace is not claimed to be a measured physical flux.
Spiritual influence is not reduced to field flow.
Boundary language does not prove theological transfer.
negative_guards: The boundary must be named before the bridge is used.
The bridge remains candidate until source/receiver and preserved structure are formalized.
kill_conditions: The bridge cannot specify what crosses the boundary.
The spiritual transfer model collapses giver and receiver into one thing.

atoms.title: Energy Flux
atoms.plain_definition: Energy flux is energy crossing a boundary per area or per modeled passage through a surface.
atoms.technical_definition: Energy flux describes the rate or density of energy transfer through a surface or region, depending on the model.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Energy flux appears where energy is not merely stored but transported across a chosen boundary.
misuse_guards: Do not use energy flux to claim grace is physical energy.
Do not ignore conservation constraints.
Do not use the phrase unless transfer rate or boundary is specified.
kill_conditions: The model cannot identify energy, boundary, or transfer mechanism.
The usage violates conservation without explicitly naming an open-system source.

atoms.title: Active Giving
atoms.plain_definition: Active giving is transfer that changes the receiver because something real is borne, offered, supplied, or poured out.
atoms.technical_definition: Active giving names a relational act in which one party supplies help, cost-bearing, instruction, mercy, or grace across a distinction without erasing either party.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Love and grace are not merely states of mind. They move toward another and change the relational field.
misuse_guards: Do not make active giving transactional only.
Do not erase consent, agency, or covenantal context.
Do not claim active giving is energy flux.
kill_conditions: The concept cannot distinguish active giving from passive approval.
The act has no identifiable receiver or changed condition.

atoms.title: Energy Flux to Active Giving
atoms.claim: Energy flux and active giving share the pattern of real transfer across a boundary that changes the receiving system.
not_claimed: Active giving is not physical energy flux.
Grace is not being measured in watts.
The analogy does not prove divine action.
negative_guards: Use as analogy unless an explicit transfer model exists.
Conservation questions must be addressed separately.
kill_conditions: The bridge turns spiritual giving into a physical unit.
The bridge cannot name a real changed condition in the receiver.

atoms.title: Equilibrium
atoms.plain_definition: Equilibrium is balance: the system is stable because the relevant forces, torques, flows, or energy tendencies are in a condition that does not drive net change of the chosen kind.
atoms.technical_definition: Equilibrium is a static, dynamic, thermal, phase, or energy-stability condition in which net driving tendencies vanish or balance under the model assumptions.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Equilibrium appears where the system's competing tendencies resolve into stable balance, restoration, or steady exchange.
misuse_guards: Do not treat equilibrium as always motionless.
Do not equate physical equilibrium with spiritual peace without a bridge atom.
Do not ignore unstable and neutral equilibrium cases.
kill_conditions: The system is not actually in a stable or balanced condition under the chosen model.
A claimed equilibrium ignores a hidden driving force, torque, or flow.

atoms.title: Peace
atoms.plain_definition: Peace is not mere absence of trouble. It is rightly ordered relation under truth, where the parts no longer war against the whole.
atoms.technical_definition: Spiritual peace is a stable relational order in which desire, action, truth, God, neighbor, and self are no longer arranged in contradiction.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Peace appears where relation has been restored or rightly ordered, not merely where visible conflict has paused.
misuse_guards: Do not confuse peace with numbness, avoidance, or suppression.
Do not reduce peace to mood.
Do not claim mechanics proves spiritual peace.
kill_conditions: The definition cannot distinguish peace from conflict avoidance.
The concept has no relation to truth, order, or reconciliation.

atoms.title: Equilibrium to Peace
atoms.claim: Equilibrium and peace share a stability-through-right-relation structure: stability is not emptiness, but ordered relation among active tendencies.
preserved_properties: distinction between stable and unstable rest
not_claimed: Peace is not a force equilibrium calculation.
Equilibrium does not prove biblical shalom.
The bridge does not reduce persons to rigid bodies.
negative_guards: The paper language should say structural correspondence, not identity.
Bridge must preserve unstable equilibrium as a warning case.
kill_conditions: The bridge cannot distinguish stable peace from suppressed conflict.
The mapping ignores that spiritual peace includes truth and relation, not mere balance.

atoms.title: Superposition
atoms.plain_definition: Superposition means compatible contributions or possible states coexist in a way the model can combine before a final net result, measurement, or actualization is specified.
atoms.technical_definition: Superposition is a principle in which a system's net state or effect is represented as a combination of components, such as forces, fields, waves, charges, heat-transfer contributions, currents, or quantum states.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Superposition appears where the governing model permits compatible contributions to be combined without destroying the identity of each contribution.
misuse_guards: Do not use quantum superposition language for all human uncertainty.
Do not ignore linearity or compatibility conditions.
Do not claim spiritual possibilities are literally quantum states.
kill_conditions: The model cannot justify additive or state-combination assumptions.
The term is used where contributions are nonlinear, incompatible, or already actualized.

atoms.title: Potential Choice
atoms.plain_definition: Potential choice is the condition before action, where several real possible responses remain open but not yet lived.
atoms.technical_definition: Potential choice names unresolved agency: the space of morally meaningful possibilities before will, faith, fear, love, or desire actualizes a path.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Persons act through time. Before action, possibility remains open in a way that matters morally and spiritually.
misuse_guards: Do not collapse potential choice into quantum mechanics.
Do not erase responsibility by making choice merely probabilistic.
Do not imply every possibility is equally good.
kill_conditions: The concept cannot distinguish possibility from fantasy.
The definition cannot account for actual responsibility after choice.

atoms.title: Superposition to Potential Choice
atoms.claim: Superposition and potential choice share a before-actualization structure: multiple possible contributions or paths remain unresolved until the system's later condition is specified.
preserved_properties: need for actualization or measurement condition
distinction between potential and lived result
not_claimed: Human choice is not claimed to be literal quantum collapse.
Faith is not reduced to measurement physics.
The bridge does not solve the measurement problem.
negative_guards: Use careful actualization language before quantum-collapse language.
Bridge grade remains candidate until compatibility conditions are formalized.
kill_conditions: The bridge requires a false popular observer-effect claim.
The spiritual side cannot distinguish potential from actualized action.

atoms.title: Random Motion
atoms.plain_definition: Random motion is motion too irregular or complex to predict particle by particle, but still describable in aggregate.
atoms.technical_definition: Random motion is unpredictable or effectively stochastic motion characterized statistically across populations, distributions, or ensembles.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Random motion appears where microscopic detail is too numerous, sensitive, or inaccessible for direct deterministic tracking, while aggregate measures still reveal structure.
misuse_guards: Do not equate random with meaningless.
Do not claim aggregate pattern implies divine message.
Do not ignore stochastic model assumptions.
kill_conditions: The motion is predictable under the intended model and not random in the stated sense.
No aggregate measure can be defined.

atoms.title: Hidden Aggregate Order
atoms.plain_definition: Hidden aggregate order is the claim that a situation can look chaotic at the local level while still revealing pattern, consequence, or providential structure at a larger scale.
atoms.technical_definition: Hidden aggregate order is a theological and interpretive concept for patterns that are not visible in isolated events but become meaningful across many events, persons, choices, or consequences.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Human beings often see events locally and immediately, while moral and spiritual patterns may become visible only through repeated outcomes.
misuse_guards: Do not use hidden order to baptize every event as obvious providence.
Do not ignore suffering or contingency.
Do not infer intention from pattern without evidence.
kill_conditions: The claimed pattern disappears under fair controls.
The interpretation cannot distinguish providence from hindsight bias.

atoms.title: Random Motion to Hidden Aggregate Order
atoms.claim: Random motion and hidden aggregate order share a scale distinction: local unpredictability does not exclude aggregate intelligibility.
not_claimed: Statistical pattern does not automatically prove providence.
Random motion is not spiritual disorder.
Aggregate order is not always moral meaning.
negative_guards: Require controls before using pattern as evidence.
Keep this bridge analogy-level until empirical or formal tests exist.
kill_conditions: The aggregate pattern fails under fair sampling.
The interpretation becomes unfalsifiable hindsight.

atoms.title: Noise
atoms.plain_definition: Noise is irregular, broadband, unwanted, or unresolved signal activity that interferes with clear detection or communication.
atoms.technical_definition: Noise is a random, broadband, turbulent, or otherwise non-signal-like component in a measurement, acoustic, communication, or physical system.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Noise appears where many uncontrolled contributions enter the channel or where resolution is insufficient to separate structured signal from background activity.
misuse_guards: Do not call every unwanted message noise.
Do not assume noise is meaningless in every context.
Do not ignore measurement limitations.
kill_conditions: The supposed noise can be decoded as a stable signal under the correct model.
The term is used to dismiss evidence rather than analyze it.

atoms.title: Confusion
atoms.plain_definition: Confusion is a condition where signals of truth, desire, fear, deception, and limitation are mixed enough that faithful response becomes harder.
atoms.technical_definition: Spiritual confusion is a distortion of discernment in which meaningful signal is obscured by falsehood, noise, fragmentation, fear, or competing allegiances.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Confusion appears when the channel between truth and action is distorted by mixed motives, false frames, bad information, or unresolved fear.
misuse_guards: Do not call honest complexity confusion.
Do not use confusion language to control others.
Do not reduce confusion to lack of faith.
kill_conditions: The concept cannot distinguish confusion from complexity.
The diagnosis ignores available truth, evidence, or counsel.

atoms.title: Noise to Confusion
atoms.claim: Noise and confusion share a signal-obscuring structure: the problem is not always absence of truth, but distortion, interference, or insufficient resolution.
preserved_properties: distinction between silence and corrupted channel
not_claimed: Confusion is not literal acoustic or electrical noise.
Noise analysis does not prove spiritual deception.
Filtering a signal is not the same as sanctification.
negative_guards: Keep analogy-level unless a formal signal model is built.
Do not dismiss hard evidence as noise without method.
kill_conditions: The bridge cannot identify signal, channel, or distortion.
The confusion claim is used to evade correction.

atoms.title: Speed Limit
atoms.plain_definition: A speed limit is a structural boundary on how fast causal influence, motion, or task completion can occur under a theory.
atoms.technical_definition: A speed limit is a physical constraint, such as the relativistic causal limit, that marks some tasks as impossible rather than merely difficult within a model's range of validity.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Speed limits appear where a theory's structure forbids certain transformations, not because engineering is weak but because coherence would break if the boundary were crossed.
misuse_guards: Do not confuse physical impossibility with moral prohibition.
Do not treat practical difficulty as structural impossibility.
Do not use speed-limit language outside a stated theory.
kill_conditions: The alleged limit is shown to be practical rather than structural.
The model has no stated range of validity.

atoms.title: Creaturely Limit
atoms.plain_definition: Creaturely limit is the boundary that comes from being finite, created, embodied, and not God.
atoms.technical_definition: Creaturely limit names the conditions under which created agents know, act, love, choose, and suffer without possessing divine omniscience, omnipotence, or self-grounding existence.
atoms.why_it_manifests_there: Created beings are real but not ultimate. Their limits are not merely defects; they are part of the structure of receiving life rather than originating it.
misuse_guards: Do not call every oppression a creaturely limit.
Do not use limit language to excuse injustice.
Do not confuse finite humility with worthlessness.
kill_conditions: The concept cannot distinguish good limits from corrupt restrictions.
The definition collapses creaturehood into failure.

atoms.title: Speed Limit to Creaturely Limit
atoms.claim: Speed limit and creaturely limit share a boundary-of-coherence structure: some limits are not failures of power but conditions for an ordered world.
not_claimed: Moral law is not derived directly from special relativity.
Creaturely limit is not the speed of light.
Physical impossibility does not equal sin.
negative_guards: Distinguish structural impossibility, practical difficulty, moral prohibition, and mystery.
Bridge remains candidate until limits are classified cleanly.
kill_conditions: The bridge treats all limits as good without distinguishing corruption.
The mapping cannot preserve the difference between physical impossibility and theological finitude.

paper_seeds.title: Peace Is Not Nothing Happening
paper_seeds.truth_bomb: A stable system is not one without forces; it is one whose forces have found their truthful relation.

paper_seeds.title: What Crosses the Boundary
paper_seeds.truth_bomb: A boundary does not make cost disappear; it makes transfer visible.

paper_seeds.title: The Difference Between Noise and Silence
paper_seeds.truth_bomb: Noise means something is happening; it does not yet tell us whether anything is being said.

mindmap_layers.description: Full Master Equation and ten factor atoms.
Physical support atoms: state, table, conservation, flux, energy flux, equilibrium, superposition, random motion, noise, speed limit.
Spiritual atoms: condition, discernment, moral accounting, transfer, active giving, peace, potential choice, hidden aggregate order, confusion, creaturely limit.
Bridge atoms with grades, guards, and kill conditions.
Paper seeds, everyday translations, receipts, objections, and later falsification tests.
